condition_cn: 条件：90分钟常规时间打平；输入包括完整90分钟预测、平局比分分布、淘汰赛证据、常规时间Tail与MAS结论。

points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段时间短且淘汰赛风险偏好下降，仍平是基础高概率分支。
points.rationale_en: Extra time is short and knockout risk appetite drops, so remaining level is the baseline high-probability branch.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
points.rationale_cn: Argentina凭借体能、替补或压迫优势在加时净胜一球。
points.rationale_en: Argentina win extra time by one goal through fitness, substitutes, or pressing advantage.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
points.rationale_cn: Cape Verde凭借体能、替补或反击效率在加时净胜一球。
points.rationale_en: Cape Verde wins extra time by one goal through fitness, bench depth or counterattack efficiency.

points.tail_title_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: Argentina在对手体能或心理崩盘后拉开比分。
points.rationale_en: Argentina pull away after the opponent collapses physically or mentally.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球
points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段比赛打开，双方各有一次有效转化。
points.tail_title_en: Open extra time / both teams score
points.rationale_en: The match opens up in extra time, with each side converting one clear chance.

points.tail_title_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段体能崩溃或开放对攻形成的低频高偏离路径。
points.rationale_en: A low-frequency tail path where fatigue or open extra-time play creates a wider scoring swing.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球，体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: Argentina加时领先后仍被对手回应，但最终净胜。
points.tail_title_en: Open extra time / both teams score, Fatigue collapse / extra-time breakthrough
points.rationale_en: Argentina leads in extra time, concedes a response, but still wins by one overall.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球，体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段体能崩溃或开放对攻形成的低频高偏离路径。
points.tail_title_en: Open extra time / both teams score, Fatigue collapse / extra-time breakthrough
points.rationale_en: A low-frequency tail path where fatigue or open extra-time play creates a wider scoring swing.

points.tail_title_en: Open extra time / both teams score

points.rationale_cn: 双方加时互有进球但仍未分胜负的补充覆盖路径。
points.rationale_en: A supplementary extra-time path where both teams score but the match remains level.

tail_focus.label: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
tail_focus.label_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
tail_focus.definition_cn: 加时30分钟内通过反击、定位球或替补冲击形成1球胜负。
tail_focus.rationale_cn: Argentina凭借体能、替补或压迫优势在加时净胜一球。
tail_focus.definition_en: A one-goal decider in 30 minutes of extra time via a counterattack, set piece, or substitute impact.
tail_focus.rationale_en: Argentina win extra time by one goal through fitness, substitutes, or pressing advantage.

tail_focus.label: 加时开放 / 双方进球
tail_focus.label_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球
tail_focus.definition_cn: 加时阶段双方均有进球，比赛从谨慎拖入开放对攻。
tail_focus.rationale_cn: 加时阶段比赛打开，双方各有一次有效转化。
tail_focus.label_en: Open extra time / both teams score
tail_focus.definition_en: Both sides score in extra time, as the match shifts from cautious to open end-to-end play.
tail_focus.rationale_en: The match opens up in extra time, with each side converting one clear chance.

tail_focus.label: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
tail_focus.label_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
tail_focus.definition_cn: 加时净胜至少2球，或总进球达到3球以上的一方打穿路径。
tail_focus.rationale_cn: Argentina在对手体能或心理崩盘后拉开比分。
tail_focus.definition_en: A side covers by winning extra time by at least 2 goals, or with total goals reaching 3+.
tail_focus.rationale_en: Argentina pull away after the opponent collapses physically or mentally.

key_factors.impact_cn: 加时入口主要来自0-0或1-1；若佛得角用4-5-1把比赛拖住，阿根廷仍有控球和二次进攻优势，但破局节奏会被压慢。
key_factors.impact_en: The main extra-time entry comes from 0-0 or 1-1. If Cape Verde’s 4-5-1 keeps the match contained, Argentina still have possession and second-phase attacking advantages, but the breakthrough tempo slows.
key_factors.text_cn: 加时入口主要来自0-0或1-1；若佛得角用4-5-1把比赛拖住，阿根廷仍有控球和二次进攻优势，但破局节奏会被压慢。
key_factors.text_en: The main extra-time entry comes from 0-0 or 1-1. If Cape Verde’s 4-5-1 keeps the match contained, Argentina still have possession and second-phase attacking advantages, but the breakthrough tempo slows.

key_factors.impact_cn: 阿根廷的加时优势来自主力休整、阵容深度和持续压迫；若梅西、劳塔罗、德保罗、麦卡利斯特或恩佐仍在场，优势会更明显。
key_factors.impact_en: Argentina’s extra-time edge comes from rested starters, squad depth and sustained pressure. It becomes stronger if Messi, Lautaro, De Paul, Mac Allister or Enzo remain on the pitch.
key_factors.text_cn: 阿根廷的加时优势来自主力休整、阵容深度和持续压迫；若梅西、劳塔罗、德保罗、麦卡利斯特或恩佐仍在场，优势会更明显。
key_factors.text_en: Argentina’s extra-time edge comes from rested starters, squad depth and sustained pressure. It becomes stronger if Messi, Lautaro, De Paul, Mac Allister or Enzo remain on the pitch.

key_factors.impact_cn: 佛得角加时的主要机会不在长期控球，而是前场定位球、低频反击和阿根廷尾段纪律风险；这是冷门路径的核心接口。
key_factors.impact_en: Cape Verde’s main extra-time route is not sustained possession, but attacking set pieces, rare counters and Argentina’s late discipline risk. This is the core interface for an upset path.
key_factors.text_cn: 佛得角加时的主要机会不在长期控球，而是前场定位球、低频反击和阿根廷尾段纪律风险；这是冷门路径的核心接口。
key_factors.text_en: Cape Verde’s main extra-time route is not sustained possession, but attacking set pieces, rare counters and Argentina’s late discipline risk. This is the core interface for an upset path.

key_factors.impact_cn: 缺少官方首发与实时换人计划，无法确认阿根廷核心是否踢满；若关键组织者提前下场，加时优势需要下调。
key_factors.impact_en: Official lineups and live substitution plans are unavailable, so it is unclear whether Argentina’s core players last into extra time. If key creators are substituted early, the extra-time edge should be reduced.

key_factors.impact_cn: 佛得角能否把低位防守维持到105分钟后，是加时阶段最大的现场验证点；抽筋、犯规和禁区解围质量会决定尾部风险。
key_factors.impact_en: Whether Cape Verde can maintain the low block beyond 105 minutes is the main live test in extra time. Cramps, fouls and box-clearance quality will determine the late-tail risk.

key_factors.text_en: Whether Cape Verde can maintain the low block beyond 105 minutes is the main live test in extra time. Cramps, fouls and box-clearance quality will determine the late-tail risk.

key_factors.impact_cn: Drew Fischer的吹罚尺度和双方背牌状态会影响阿根廷反抢强度，也会影响佛得角通过定位球偷袭的机会。
key_factors.impact_en: Drew Fischer’s refereeing standard and each side’s card state can affect Argentina’s counter-pressing intensity and Cape Verde’s chance to create set-piece ambushes.
